2주 The WSJ is reporting on a looming debt wall for private equity backed companies. According to the article, PE funds are using cash from new funds to invest preferred equity as a sweetener to get lenders to agree to maturity extensions. For founders with rollover equity, this will dilute your return upon exit. Check the constituent documents, including any stockholders' agreement, for any veto or consent rights. For prospective rollover founders, be aware of this risk. It is a question of degree, but preferred equity could wipe out any return to the common holders in an exit scenario, similar to participating preferred in a VC deal. "[PE fund], which had just raised a $15 billion fund, gave the [portfolio company] $175 million in exchange for preferred shares. Lenders extended due dates for the debt to 2030 and 2031, made an additional loan of roughly $100 million and agreed that [portfolio company] could defer some interest payments. 3주 Can a 0.61% difference cost you ₹7.53 lakh? While analysing mutual funds, I explored how expense ratios can impact long-term wealth creation. I compared the Regular and Direct Growth plans of Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund. Both share the same fund manager and underlying portfolio, but differ in expense ratio due to the distribution structure. Regular Plan: 1.30% Direct Plan: 0.69% On an illustrative ₹10 lakh investment, this difference translates to ₹7.53 lakh over 13 years. The takeaway? Compounding works both ways. It can help grow your wealth, but recurring costs can quietly work against it. 3주 0.61%의 차이가 7.53만 루피의 비용을 발생시킬 수 있을까요? 뮤추얼 펀드를 분석하면서, 저는 총보수(expense ratio)가 장기적인 부의 형성에 어떤 영향을 미칠 수 있는지 살펴보았습니다. Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund의 일반(Regular) 플랜과 다이렉트(Direct) 성장 플랜을 비교했습니다. 두 플랜 모두 동일한 펀드 매니저와 기초 자산을 공유하지만, 판매 구조로 인해 총보수에서 차이가 납니다. 일반 플랜: 1.30% 다이렉트 플랜: 0.69% 10만 루피를 투자한 예시에서, 이 차이는 13년 동안 7.53만 루피에 달합니다. 시사점은 무엇일까요? 복리는 양방향으로 작용합니다. 자산을 키우는 데 도움이 될 수 있지만, 반복되는 비용은 조용히 자산에 불리하게 작용할 수 있습니다. 제 분석 내용을 아래에 공유합니다. #MutualFunds #PersonalFinance #Compounding #InvestmentAnalysis #Finance #UniversityBusinessSchool 댓글을 보거나 남기려면 로그인
